new: The performance run now keeps its error messages, not only how many there were. Each different message goes into the run log as it first comes, with its time, story and segment.
A message that comes again is counted, not sent again; the counts go at the run's end. After 60 different messages a run only counts.
Messages lose addresses' queries and hashes, room codes and relay passwords before they are kept or sent.
The results card says how many messages were different and names the two most frequent.
notes.mjs perf and perfrun print a table of the errors and warnings. Older runs say their messages were not recorded.
test: On a Quest: a full performance run with developer mode on, then read it with notes.mjs perfrun: the errors section should name each message.
Compare its count of errors with the results card's.
A run on a page: Download JSON should hold errlist with the same messages.
untested: The errors of a real headset run: what the Quest Browser's messages say, and whether 60 different ones are enough.
A plain Record a run still records no errors: only the performance run catches them.
